scripts.ready: vp run -r build && vp check && vp run test:coverage
scripts.dev: vp run api-contract#build && vp run --filter api-contract --filter api --filter website --parallel dev
scripts.test: vp run --filter api-contract --filter api --filter website test
scripts.test:coverage: vp run --filter api-contract --filter api --filter website test:coverage
scripts.test:all: vp run test:coverage && vp run test:e2e
